newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 slides at open after Wall Street drop.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 slides at open after Wall Street drop.

text.p: Leading UK shares tumbled at the open on Friday after Wall Street posted its biggest one-day decline in weeks.
By 0841 GMT, the FTSE 100 was off 14.4 points to 4,341.7, well off the day's low at 4,334.3.
The Dow, down 18 points when London markets closed, finished with a 92.36-point loss at 6,927.77.
"The feeling is that we are very much at the top of the range and the market is going to be volatile," said one dealer.
The 1030 GMT expiry of February equity index options could inject another dose of volatility into UK shares, dealers said.
